institutions and perceptions of design's social role."},{"id":"principles","objective":"Define approved strategic and design principles that frame design as a responsible method for change."},{"id":"process_model","objective":"Translate that positioning into a clear, repeatable model that can organize messaging and identity behavior."},{"id":"structure_spec","objective":"Specify brand architecture, content hierarchy, touchpoint priorities, formats and requirements across digital, signage, print and merchandise."},{"id":"explore_concepts","objective":"Develop meaningfully different identity directions that express the approved strategy and process model."},{"id":"select_direction","objective":"Evaluate directions against agreed criteria and obtain an explicit client choice."},{"id":"prototype_test","objective":"Test the selected direction in rough digital interfaces, signage, print and merchandise applications for clarity, accessibility and coherence."},{"id":"refine","objective":"Apply stakeholder and testing feedback while preserving approved strategic and conceptual decisions."},{"id":"identity_system","objective":"Codify the logo, typography, colour, graphic language, motion or interaction behavior and governance rules."},{"id":"expand_assets","objective":"Extend the approved identity across prioritized institutional touchpoints and reusable templates."},{"id":"production_file","objective":"Prepare technically valid masters for the confirmed digital, print, environmental and merchandise outputs."}],"reference_observations":[],"deliverable_concepts":["brand_strategy","logo_system","visual_identity","environmental_graphics","merchandise_family","brand_applications","mockups","prototype","production_spec"],"missing_inputs":["Institution name, location, history and current positioning","Existing identity assets, guidelines and evidence of heritage elements that retain equity","Mission, institutional strategy and an approved definition of responsible change","Primary and secondary audiences, stakeholder concerns and access to research participants","Brand architecture for schools, programs, departments, initiatives and partnerships","Competitive or peer set and desired points of distinction","Complete touchpoint inventory and rollout priorities","Digital platform constraints and accessibility requirements","Signage locations, dimensions, wayfinding needs, codes, materials and fabrication constraints","Print formats, quantities, distribution needs and printer specifications","Merchandise categories, suppliers, decoration methods, size ranges and unit economics","Approved institutional claims, messaging hierarchy and required content","Sustainability, inclusion and procurement standards","Budget, schedule, internal capabilities and rollout or migration plan","Decision-makers, approval stages and success metrics","Trademark, naming, licensing, font and image-rights constraints"],"assumptions":["The institution seeks an evolution of its existing identity rather than a rename or merger-level brand architecture change.","The identity should preserve valuable heritage only after that equity is identified through research.","Responsible change will be defined and substantiated by the institution before it becomes a public-facing claim.","Digital, signage, print and merchandise applications will initially be representative priority touchpoints rather than an exhaustive asset inventory.","Accessibility, inclusive communication and environmentally responsible production will be evaluation criteria.","Final technical specifications will be adapted to confirmed platforms, sites and vendors."],"stop_conditions":["Do not begin concept exploration until positioning, priority audiences, brand architecture and heritage equities are approved.","Do not advance beyond direction selection without an explicit human or client decision.","Pause if the institution cannot approve or substantiate claims connecting its programs to responsible change.","Do not finalize the identity system until naming and trademark risks have been reviewed by the responsible legal party.","Do not prepare production masters for any touchpoint lacking final content, dimensions, platform requirements or vendor specifications.","Do not release signage or merchandise files without accessibility, safety, material, fabrication and licensing approvals.","Do not hand off final assets until scope, quality checks, usage rights, governance ownership and rollout responsibilities are accepted."],"rationale":"The brief calls for a strategy-led identity evolution rather than a standalone visual refresh. The workflow therefore establishes institutional meaning and a communicable design-process model before visual exploration, requires explicit direction selection, tests the chosen idea across the named media, and only then codifies and extends the system. Final delivery is excluded because the incomplete brief does not yet establish the approvals and production inputs required for a valid handoff.","confidence":0.91}
